title: System Whisper
description:
A fictional security workstation named `white-rabbit` was captured during a lab exercise. The analyst saved this simulated system information:

```
$ uname -a
Linux white-rabbit 6.6.1-lab #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC x86_64 GNU/Linux
$ whoami
analyst
```

The workstation hostname is the first artifact requested by the lab instructor.
objective: Submit the workstation hostname wrapped as HC{hostname}.

hints.text: The hostname appears immediately after the kernel name in uname output.
Look at the second token on the uname line.
